title: LessonBlocksField uses inline styles instead of design system tokens
body: The LessonBlocksField component (src/ui/admin/LessonBlocksField/index.tsx) uses inline style={{}} objects for all styling instead of Tailwind classes with design system tokens. Should be migrated to use semantic tokens per the design system rules in design-system.md.
rationale: Design system compliance — all interactive elements should use Tailwind + semantic design tokens, not inline styles.
